caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object centrally placed against a plain, light beige background. The object is an ornate, gold-colored decorative piece featuring the form of an eagle with spread wings. The eagle's head faces to the left, and there are detailed feather engravings visible on its wings and body. In the center of the eagle's body, there is an oval area with the etched letters "I.O.W.A." Below the eagle, the lower part of the object forms a loop or a U-shaped handle, attached just underneath the bird's body. A small signature, reading "W.L. Walton," appears in brownish ink on the lower right side of the image. The drawing uses shading and color gradients to give the golden object a three-dimensional appearance, set against the unadorned background.
title: Door Knocker
